editorial.blurb: Ayayay brings genuine Mexican flavors and exceptional hospitality to every plate, from hand-rolled cheesy yuca balls to charcoal-grilled tacos that have left diners speechless.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask for their homemade hot sauce on the side—it packs real heat from what appears to be guajillo peppers, and arrive early or expect a wait given the consistently packed dining room.
